details.summary: What types of companies do you work with?
details.p: Startups, SMBs, and scale-ups: B2B, e-commerce, and services. The key is having a minimum level of traction.

details.summary: How long before we see results?
details.p: Often quick wins within 10–14 days. Structural results are typically measured over 30–90 days.
Yes: workshops + implementation (CRM, dashboards, processes, pages). Everything is documented for the team.
Weekly rituals, a KPI dashboard, and async support (Slack/WhatsApp/Email depending on the framework).
